concerns.text: Success Criterion SC-004 (total execution time ≤ 6 hours) has no corresponding task; the pipeline never records or checks the overall runtime against the GitHub Actions budget.
Success Criterion SC-005 (Sandbox Stability Rate ≥ 99 %) is not covered by any task; no task computes or validates the proportion of tasks that complete without runner crashes or hangs.

FR-004 defines the error type name "Logic Transfer Failure", but Task T014 and the generation‑result schemas use the shorter label "Logic Transfer". This naming mismatch may leave the requirement unimplemented or ambiguous.

Constitution Principle VI mandates explicit detection of "logic drift" failures, yet the only failure category implemented is "Logic Transfer" (Task T014). No separate "logic drift" category exists, so the principle is not satisfied.
The dependency table lists T004 as a prerequisite for T010, but T004 is the feasibility‑gate script, not the linting setup (which is T003). This inconsistency is a minor documentation error.
